project_type: MERN stack monorepo: Express/Node.js backend + React/Vite frontend + FastAPI Python AI service
build_system: Backend: plain Node.js, no bundler (CommonJS require). Frontend: Vite (npm run build). Python: uvicorn via aiServiceClient spawn. No workspace tooling — backend and frontend are independent packages under the repo root.
test_framework: None configured. Verification is done with `node --check` (syntax), `python -m py_compile` (Python syntax), and `npm run build` (frontend bundle).
build_command: Frontend: cd frontend && npm run build. Backend syntax: node --check <file>. Python syntax: python -m py_compile <file>.
test_command: No automated test suite. Use node --check for JS, python -m py_compile for Python, npm run build for frontend.
verification_instructions: 1. node --check on every new/modified JS file. 2. python -m py_compile on every new/modified Python file. 3. npm run build from frontend/ — must complete without errors. 4. node backend/server.js — must reach DB connect attempt without MODULE_NOT_FOUND or SyntaxError.
environment_constraints: Windows (PowerShell). Paths with spaces require quoting. Backend runs on port 5000, Python AI on port 8001. Do NOT restart or kill any running server processes. Never push to git. Always use CommonJS (require/module.exports) in backend — no ES module syntax.
contribution_requirements: DO NOT delete or modify any existing code — only ADD. All new Mongoose schema fields must be optional with safe defaults. Use express-async-handler in all controllers. Use createAndNotify for all notifications. Python engine must be deterministic (no LLM calls). Never expose secrets.
key_patterns: Controllers: const asyncHandler = require('express-async-handler'); all functions are asyncHandler wrappers; module.exports = { fn1, fn2 }. Routes: const router = express.Router(); router.route('/').get(...).post(...); module.exports = router. Models: mongoose.Schema + optional fields with defaults + module.exports = mongoose.model('Name', schema). Notifications: createAndNotify(req.app, { recipient, title, message, type, priority, link }). Frontend services: import { api } from './api'; named exports + default export object.
directory_structure: backend/ — Express server, models/, controllers/, routes/, middleware/, services/, utils/, ai/ (FastAPI + engines/). frontend/src/ — React app, services/, components/, pages/, context/. .agents/tasks/ — plan and FEAT artifacts (NOT inside the worktree commit).
